content.welcome: Welcome to Inspire Wallet. Please read these terms and conditions carefully before accessing, using, or obtaining any materials, information, products or services. By accessing the Inspire Wallet (collectively, "The app"), you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions ("Terms") and our Privacy Policy. In these Terms "we", "us", "our" and "Inspire Wallet" refers to Inspire Wallet, and"I", "you", and "your" refers to you, the user of our application.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.content: You must be at least 18 years old and have the legal capacity to enter into contracts. By using our app, you represent that you meet the requirements. If you are located in a jurisdiction where investment services are restricted, you may not use the app.

accountRegistration.title: Account Registration
accountRegistration.content: To access the maximum capacity of the app, you must create an account. You agree to:

bulletPoints.passwordSecurity: Maintain the security of your password
bulletPoints.unauthorizedUse: In case of any unauthorized use of your account, kindly notify us immediately

servicesProvided.title: Services Provided
servicesProvided.content: Inspire Wallet tracks your stocks and investment and lets you monitor your money before and after withdrawal. Every transaction shall be made through email and not directly with the bank. Inspire Alliance Fund Group will process your transaction, not the app itself. The process could take approximately five (5) to seven (7) working days to reflect on your Inspire Wallet account.

feesAndCharges.title: Fees and Charges
feesAndCharges.content: Details about fees associated with transactions, account maintenance, and other services will be provided in-app and may change from time to time.

userResponsibilities.title: User Responsibilities
userResponsibilities.content: You agree to use the app for lawful purposes and to abide by all applicable laws and regulations. You are responsible for your account and investment decisions.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: All content, trademarks, and software related to are owned by Inspire Alliance Fund Group or its licensors. You are granted a limited, non-exclusive license to use the app for personal purposes.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.content: Your use of the app is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which details how we collect, use, and protect your personal information. The app only collects data such as your name, email address and bank details.

changesToTerms.title: Changes to Terms
changesToTerms.content: We may modify these terms at any time. We will notify you of significant changes through the app or via email. Your continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

contactDetails.title: Contact Details
contactDetails.content: For questions or concerns regarding these terms, please contact us at

content.agreement: I hereby agree that I have read and fully understood the Terms and conditions and agree to be bound by the statements above.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: We value your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our app, "Inspire Wallet."

informationCollection.title: What Information We Collect
informationCollection.content: We collect the following types of data:

bulletPoints.personalInfo: Personal Information: Your name, email address, and other details you provide.
bulletPoints.usageData: Usage Data: Information like your device type, IP address, and how you use the app.

bulletPoints.contactUpdates: Contact you with updates or important notices.
bulletPoints.monitorUsage: Monitor how the app is used to enhance performance.

informationSharing.title: Sharing Your Information
informationSharing.content: We may share your data with:

bulletPoints.serviceProviders: Service providers who help us run the app.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We take steps to protect your information, but no system is 100% secure. Always be cautious when sharing data online.

childrensPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.content: We do not collect data from anyone under 13. If you believe your child has shared data with us, contact us to remove it.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: You can update or delete your personal data by logging into your account or contacting us.

policyChanges.title: Changes to This Policy
policyChanges.content: We may update this policy. Check this page for the latest version.

contactUs.title: Contact Us
contactUs.content: If you have any questions, email us at

ourCompany.title: Our Company
ourCompany.content: At Inspire Alliance Fund Group Inc., we are driven by a powerful purpose: to empower dreams and ignite meaningful change. Founded on the belief that lasting progress begins with opportunity, we exist to support individuals who are ready to make a difference—not just in their own lives, but in the communities around them. We go beyond traditional funding. We are a dynamic movement that bridges passionate visionaries with the support, trust, and resources they need to transform ideas into lasting impact.

ourMission.title: Our Mission
ourMission.content: At Inspire Alliance Fund Group Inc., our mission is to ignite change by empowering dreams. We believe that real progress begins when individuals are given the resources, trust, and opportunities to build a better future not just for themselves, but for their communities and beyond. We are more than a funding platform; we are a movement that connects purpose-driven people with the support they need to turn ideas into impact. By investing in human potential, we cultivate a ripple effect supporting lives, strengthening economies, and shaping a future where hope and innovation thrive together.

inspireWallet.title: Inspire Wallet
inspireWallet.content: Inspire Wallet, our flagship app for Inspire Investors, embodies this vision. Designed as your all-in-one financial companion, Inspire Wallet allows you to:

bulletPoints.investments: Stay on top of your investments
bulletPoints.transactions: Keep a clear record of all your financial transactions

inspireWallet.conclusion: Whether you're a seasoned investor or just getting started, our app provides all the tools you need to manage your portfolio with ease and confidence.

content.callToAction: Join us at Inspire Alliance Fund Group Incorporated and together, let's shape a prosperous future. Download Inspire Wallet today and take control of your financial journey!
